title.zh: Payments Giant Stripe and Plasma Roll Out Multi-Currency Stablecoin Cards Across
title.en: Payments Giant Stripe and Plasma Roll Out Multi-Currency Stablecoin Cards Across

current_state.zh: Stripe partnered with Plasma to launch multi-currency stablecoin cards that let users spend directly from local-currency or stablecoin balances across 30+ markets, with plans to reach 100+ countries by 2027.
